proveedoresPage.metaDesc: How ContrataCR's identity verification works: we confirm the ID is real and the name matches official records. We verify identity, not the quality or outcome of the work.
proveedoresPage.intro: It's a confirmation that the provider's ID is real and that their name matches official records. It's automatic and earned: it gives more visibility to clients seeking extra trust, without blocking anyone.
proveedoresPage.step1Body: We automatically confirm that the ID number (cédula, DIMEX or NITE) exists in the official TSE records.
proveedoresPage.step2Body: We pull your official name straight from the TSE padrón. Your verification is granted instantly, no waiting.
proveedoresPage.step3Body: The padrón is updated periodically. If your case doesn't pass automatically, you can appeal and it's re-verified.
proveedoresPage.disclaimer: ContrataCR is an intermediary platform that connects clients with service providers; it is not the service provider. The “Verified” badge only confirms the ID is real and the name matches official records. It does not guarantee or ensure the quality, outcome or completion of any work, and does not by itself prove that the person who registered is physically that person. Hiring happens directly between the client and the provider.

comoFunciona.faqSubtitle: We answer the most common questions about ContrataCR.
comoFunciona.faq0A: ContrataCR connects people looking for services with people who offer them. We don't charge commissions on services: you arrange payment directly with the professional, off the platform.
comoFunciona.faq1Q: What does it mean for a profile to be verified?
comoFunciona.faq1A: We confirm their identity by comparing the ID against the Civil Registry (TSE) records. The 'Verified' badge means the person is real and verifiable, not a rating of their work quality. Verified professionals show the 'Verified' badge; those without it simply do not show one, with no negative label.
comoFunciona.faq2Q: How do I coordinate the service?
comoFunciona.faq2A: We put you in direct contact with the professional via WhatsApp. No middlemen or commissions: you agree on the price, date, and time directly with them.
comoFunciona.faq3A: You can post a request describing exactly what you need. The professionals who offer that service will see your post and send you proposals with price and availability. You choose who to work with.
comoFunciona.faq4Q: How do I leave a review?
comoFunciona.faq4A: After completing a service, you can leave a review from your client dashboard. Reviews are verified and can only be left by clients who actually used the service.
comoFunciona.ctaSubtitle: Search verified professionals in Costa Rica or post a request for free.

ayuda.faqSubtitle: The most common questions from our community.
ayuda.faq0Q: Does ContrataCR charge any commission or fee?
ayuda.faq0A: We don't charge commissions on the services you hire: you arrange payment directly with the professional, off the platform.
ayuda.faq1Q: How do I start offering services?
ayuda.faq1A: Click 'Offer my services' in the navigation bar. You can sign up with your email or with Google/Facebook. The process has 2 steps: first you select your service type and area, then you upload a photo and describe your experience. It takes less than 5 minutes.
ayuda.faq2A: We compare the ID against the Civil Registry (TSE) records. When it matches, the profile shows the 'Verified' badge. It's an identity check (confirming the person is real and verifiable), not a rating of work quality. Those without it simply do not show the badge, with no negative label.
ayuda.faq3Q: How do I search for a service?
ayuda.faq3A: Use the search bar on the home page or the services search page. You can search by service type (plumber, psychologist, designer, etc.), by province and canton, and sort by rating. The search understands synonyms — if you type 'nanny' it will also find childcare professionals.
ayuda.faq4Q: How do I coordinate the service?
ayuda.faq4A: Two ways. If you search directly, open the professional's profile and we connect you via WhatsApp to coordinate. If you post a request, professionals send you proposals and you coordinate via WhatsApp with whoever you choose. You agree on price, date, and details with no middlemen.
ayuda.faq5Q: How do I leave a review?
ayuda.faq5A: After a service is completed, you can leave a review from your panel, in Client mode → My requests. Only clients who actually hired that service can leave reviews — that keeps them authentic.
ayuda.faq6A: Posting a request is an alternative to searching directly. You describe what you need (for example: 'painting a 4x4m living room, budget ₡80,000'), and the professionals who offer that service in your area send you proposals with their price. You choose who to work with.
ayuda.faq7A: Yes. Your phone number and email are never publicly visible on the platform. When you make contact, you do so directly via WhatsApp. We comply with Costa Rica's Data Protection Law 8968.

atraerClientes.subtitle: Practical, honest tips for people offering services who want to grow in the Costa Rican market.
atraerClientes.tip0Body: Clients decide in seconds whether to trust someone. A clear, well-lit photo where your face is visible builds far more trust than a profile with no photo or a low-quality one.
atraerClientes.tip0Highlight: No blurry photos, dark glasses, or party pics.
atraerClientes.tip1Body: Verification confirms your identity with Costa Rica's Civil Registry (it doesn't certify the quality of your work, but it proves you're a real, verifiable person). Verified professionals appear first in results and show the 'Verified' badge.
atraerClientes.tip1Highlight: Verified professionals show higher in search.
atraerClientes.tip2Body: Photos of real work are your portfolio. Before hiring, clients will want to see examples of your work. A renovated kitchen, a well-kept garden, a design you made — any real photo of your work is worth a lot.
atraerClientes.tip2Highlight: Photos of your work build more trust.
atraerClientes.tip3Body: In Costa Rica, service coordination almost always happens on WhatsApp, and people expect quick replies. If a client messages you and you take hours to reply, they've probably already contacted someone else. Turn on notifications and reply as soon as possible.
atraerClientes.tip3Highlight: Response speed is your biggest differentiator.
atraerClientes.tip4Title: Ask for reviews after every job
atraerClientes.tip4Body: Reviews are gold. After completing a job, ask the client to leave you a review on ContrataCR. A short line like 'Could you leave me a review on the platform? It really helps me get more clients' is enough. Most people are happy to do it.
atraerClientes.tip5Body: Set your coverage zones (province and canton) in your profile. Clients filter by canton, so the more precise your areas, the more relevant searches you appear in. If you travel across the Greater Metropolitan Area, say so in your coverage.
atraerClientes.tip6Body: Avoid generic phrases like 'I'm the best in Costa Rica' or 'I work with quality'. Instead, describe exactly what you do, how many years of experience you have, and what types of jobs are your specialty. Specificity builds trust.
atraerClientes.tip6Highlight: Example: '12 years as an electrician. Specialized in residential installations and ICE-certified.'
atraerClientes.tip7Body: If you're busy for two weeks, mark it on your calendar. Clients who see you're available for the date they need are far more likely to contact you. A profile with updated availability conveys seriousness and commitment.
atraerClientes.dosDontsSubtitle: The difference between someone with many clients and someone with none is usually this:
dos: Give an approximate price in the first message
Arrive on time or warn if you're running late
donts: Ignore messages and reply days later
Give prices very different from the initial quote
Cancel at the last minute without a serious reason
Ask for full payment before starting
atraerClientes.marketTitle: The Costa Rican market — how it works in practice
atraerClientes.market0Body: In Costa Rica, service coordination happens mostly on WhatsApp. Whether you're in San José or Liberia, people expect to message you there and get a quick reply. Keeping your WhatsApp number updated and active is essential.
atraerClientes.market1Body: Costa Ricans are cautious about who enters their home or handles their work. ID verification, real photos of your work, and reviews from people known in the local community make a huge difference versus an anonymous profile.
atraerClientes.market2Body: Clients usually search 'plumber in Desamparados' or 'nanny in Heredia', not simply 'plumber' or 'nanny'. Being specific about the cantons where you work positions you better in those local searches.
atraerClientes.market3Body: Costa Rican clients don't always go for the cheapest — they go for whoever conveys the most trust. A slightly higher price with good photos, reviews, and a complete profile almost always wins over a cheap profile with no information.
